name: Indigenous Peoples' Day
raw: Indigenous Peoples' Day | Oct 12 2026, all day | Indigenous Peoples' Day honors the culture and history of Native people past, present, and future. Join us at Gichigamiin Indigenous Nations Museum to celebrate the diversity and vibrancy of Indigenous cultures with FREE admission to the museum all day. Bring your friends and your family to enrich your understanding of Indigenous histories and cultures and enjoy guided craft activities.

name: November Free Day
raw: November Free Day | Wed Nov 25 2026, 10:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. | Join us for a day of free admission at Gichigamiin Indigenous Nations Museum. Our monthly Museum Free Days will now include Indigenous Artists Pop-Up Markets!

name: Dagwaagin (Fall) Artist Market – Small Business Saturday
raw: Dagwaagin (Fall) Artist Market – Small Business Saturday | Sat Nov 28 2026, 10am-3pm | Admission is FREE. Native artists and small businesses; start your holiday shopping early and show your support for local Native American Small Businesses.

name: December Free Day
